title: XRPH staking launches inside XRPH Wallet
description: XRP Healthcare launched fixed-term XRPH staking inside XRPH Wallet with advertised 20% APR for six-month terms and 25% APR for twelve-month terms.
notes: APR figures are recorded as advertised product terms only and are not treated as verified realized returns.

title: XRP Healthcare stops accepting new XRPH stakes
description: XRP Healthcare announced that it would stop accepting new XRPH staking contracts while allowing existing stakes to continue until their contractual terms expired.
notes: This is a stop-new-stakes event, not a verified same-day termination of all existing staking positions.

title: Forensic review discloses server-side seed transmission in staking flows
description: XRPL.to reported from decompiled and runtime-reviewed XRPH Wallet code that staking and unstaking flows transmitted user seed material to an XRP Healthcare server. The finding materially changes the historical custody/key-control risk profile of the yield facility.
notes: CYA does not assert that this staking path caused the full September 2026 XRPH Wallet drain; the forensic investigation states that most drained wallets had never staked.
